lawyer:
Mr. Serajul Islam Chowdhury, Advocate ------ For the Petitioners
Mr. Moazzem Hossain, Deputy Attorney General ------ For the State
parties:
Md. Amjad Hossain and others ------ Petitioners
Vs.
The State ------ Opposite Party
full_judgment: 7. Mr. Khan, the learned Advocate appearing in support of the rule has taken us through the impugned orders and the various other Annexures appended to the petition including the order sheets and the averments made in this petition, submitted that in the instant case, the Sessions court below was dealing with the alleged murder case and the petitioners are the accused in that alleged offence of homicide amounting to murder. They had the right of the presumption that they are innocent till they are proved to be guilty and need be allowed a fair trial which was denied to them. in the instant case the court being influenced by the Special Public Prosecutor who went from Dhaka and exerted his influence upon the court made that court to pass the order rejecting the prayer of the petitioner to examine prosecution witnesses earlier called as court's witnesses, but if they would have deposed would prove that the prosecution story is totally malafide and concocted and that the accused had no complicity in the alleged offence of murder but this was denied to them with malafide motive being biased against the accused by the presiding Judge. He has further submitted that the defence had been very seriously prejudiced in the instant case because the Post-Mortem Report has been admitted without it being legally proved by the Doctor and it has been admitted into evidence without examining the Doctor at all and admitted into evidence without any application by the prosecution for its admission in the absence of the Doctor as provided under Section 509A of the Code of Criminal Procedure and this was also done by the court being influenced by the Special Public Prosecutor and both the court and the Public Prosecutor had been enemical to the defence when, in fact, under the law it is the duty of the lawyer only to assist the court and not to influence the court. He further submitted that the time limitation of 260 days would the no ground to deny the procedural right to the petitioner by the court, because those rights are not merely procedural but are vested rights. He has further submitted that the Investigating Officer in the instant case has also been examined and the charge-sheet and the FIR was admitted into the evidence without having it proved legally and the Investigation officer had not been allowed to be cross-examined by the defence who was absent and it had seriously prejudiced the defence in the process and this was done with motive and, therefore, this case which is at the fag and should be transferred to the other court because accused would not get a fair trial from that court. He lastly submitted that for reasons of this had behaviour of the learned Deputy Attorney-General Mr. Moazzam Hossain who acted beyond his power as lawyer and influenced the court had turned trial into a mockery.
